response_text: From August 2021 through August 2023, about 14 in 100 U.S. adults age 20 and older (13.8%) had low HDL cholesterol — the "good" cholesterol that helps protect against heart disease. Low HDL was roughly three times as common in men (21.5%) as in women (6.6%), and men had higher rates than women in every age group.
